claimContract.allowedSentence: Amu native is fastest among the enumerated implementations (rustc, Apple Clang C11, Zig, Go c-shared, and Swift) on all six required domains, on one recorded Darwin arm64 machine using native execution, under the named perfgate policy.
claimContract.aggregationPolicy: the candidate must independently beat every required comparator in every required domain; no aggregate may hide a loss, missing arm, or unqualified arm
claimContract.nativeArtifactInvocation: one external C runner invokes both candidate and comparator through the same eight-i64-argument indirect-call boundary; loading, mapping and symbol resolution occur before timing

contract.workflow: prepare-all -> bounded quiet gate -> measure sealed bundles
contract.externalComparators: optional adapters measured outside the compiler and runtime dependency closure

quietGate.policy: busy-cpu-fraction <= 0.10 over 1s, three consecutive samples; load1 recorded as diagnostic

reasons.note: the arms are closer together than their own spread
